column4: Type A resumes after a dodge or an empty net (via ElfSt_64 = handler[base+1]): restores depth (-10), walks AWAY from the player (base 5/anim 0x20 if the elf is right of the player, else base 1/0x1f; carrier 0x42/0x41); DS:5d6c[2,6]
Type B resumes after a dodge (handler[base+1]): depth -10, walks away from the player (base 13/anim 0x24 or base 9/0x23); DS:5d6c[10,14]
Type C resumes after a dodge (handler[base+1]): depth -10, walks away from the player (base 21/anim 0x2e or 17/0x2d); DS:5d6c[18,22]
Coin creature hidden (state 25/26): becomes visible (anim 0x56, state 70) only on the tick it gets a sprite slot and only if coins < 4 and nets < 5; never moves while hidden
Type A walking: Elf_CheckNet; rand() every call, pause (anim 0x21, state 47) when rand()&15==0 AND the slot is idle (i.e. once per finished walk cycle); then Anim_SetIfIdle(anim)

Elf dust flying left (dust = child slot, x offset -1 byte per tick): hit if |dustX - playerX| < 10 bytes, coins > 0, player y&0x78==0x70, player state not 17..20 -> coins-1, state 54, anim 0x29; at offset -0x50 the dust vanishes (no return), walk left (state 49)
Elf dust returning with the stolen coin after a hit (left throw): child x offset +1 per tick until 0, then anim 0x2b, state 55
Elf dust flying right: as ElfSt_53 mirrored, but only player states 17..18 (jump left) avoid a hit; at +0x50 vanishes, walk right (state 50)
Coin creature collected: when anim 0x59 ends, Elf_Release, respawn at a random x of the level range (rand), coins += 2
Coin creature: player within +-5 bytes and not jumping -> state 72, anim 0x59 (sfx 4); net class >= 4 -> state 71, runs away from the player (anim 0x57/0x58, sfx 3)
Escaped elf (1/64 dodge): child sprite y += 2 per tick; released when the offset exceeds 0xa2

Net catch resolution (states 63/66): nets==0 -> elf gets up (anim base+0x35, state 64); else if the player is still swinging (states 21..26, carrier 21..25) and no quiz: nets-1 unless another catch already resolved this tick (DS:a20a, reset every Elves_Update), coins+1; carrier -> quiz (DS:921e, uiMode|=2, state 67); other -> zip away (anim 0x4d/0x4e, state 69)

While a search runs and the slot is idle: freeze (state 68, anim 0x22). Else by net class DS:a20c: 4 -> dodge hop away from the net centre (state 64) or with rand()&63==0 escape (state 73, anim 0x4f); 5/6 -> pulled to the net centre (state 62/65)

At every scene change to a mountain level: clears 15 elves, DS:a212 = 15 (7 on a slow CPU); spawns by DS:5d34[tier] in the order type A (base 1/5, first carriers get question slots 1..n), D coin creature (25), B thrower (9/13), C (17/21); one rand() per elf for x

(was Castle_ResetCells) The 9 cells of DS:120a whose picture changes in play (bonus-coin spot 0x26, gates 0xef, 0xae, 0x79 and its mirror 0x88, net-shop doors 0xbc and 0xea, animated obstacles 0x84 and 0xb7) get their default pictures DS:121c, content 0x80

Tier from the total (>=230:3, >=115:2, >=25:1; below 25 tier unchanged), t=tier+2 treasures, decoys t+3/t+2/t+1 (t at level 2 when total>=381); places 0..places-1 take the next picture (cyclic from rand()%count) matching the key in exactly 2/1/0 attributes; treasure id: rand()%48 then +1 cyclic, skipping collected/showcase/placed ids, accepted anyway after 48 tries

(was g_castleCells) Cells whose picture changes in play and is saved (record +0xBB+48): 0x26 bonus coins, 0x79/0x88 level-2 gate, 0xae level-1 gate, 0xef level-0 gate, 0xbc/0xea net shops, 0x84/0xb7 animated obstacles
(was g_castleDefaultPics) Default pictures of DS:120a
Per mountain level: picture count, key picture (set by Layout_PlaceKey), unused (always 0, saved), places excluding the key (18/13/10)
Elves per tier, columns: A walker/carrier, B thrower, C walker, D coin creature (3/0..6/3/3); spawn order A, D, B, C
Elves holding a sprite (+1 on a slow CPU); a new sprite only while < 3
Tier at Game_End (for the found-all end message)
Key picture of the level being laid out (Layout_PlaceKey -> Clue_BuildWords)
Cell of the level-1 key (Layout_PutInSlot); written, never read
Cell of the level-2 key (Layout_PutInSlot); written, never read
g_slowCpu as at game start/restore; elves only run while g_slowCpu == this (ladder-jump/castle code clears g_slowCpu temporarily)
Elf x relative to the camera, bytes (strip-linear)
Elf y within the cell relative to the camera
Player sprite x - 2 (slot 1), bytes
Catches resolved in this Elves_Update (first one uses a net); reset at its end
Elf_Think result: 0 none, 1 released, 2 got a sprite, 3 visible, 4 net edge (dodge), 5 net, 6 net centre
+1 per Elf_Think call; bit 1 gates hidden-elf drift; 0 when a search freeze ends
Scratch: animation id offset (0 / 0x16 carrier) shared by the elf handlers; ElfSt_03 reads the stale value
Elves processed: 15, or 7 on a slow CPU (set by Elves_Spawn)
1 = Hints_Update resets g_seconds and the hint timers (set by Game_Start and the Options hint switch)
0 while a frame-side handler reads g_cmd; Input_Poll then queues one command in DS:90f6
INT 33h/3 buttons (Mouse_Poll)
Buttons of the previous Mouse_Poll
Status-bar prompt frame = 60 + value/2 (4: drop coin, 6: Enter to go on)
Initial 1; alternates the two champion end messages (35, then 36)
g_seconds+1 when the second clue word of a level was seen (hint 3)
